name: Bioluminescent Book Garden at Night
description: A nighttime garden where open books glow like luminous flowers, surrounded by fireflies and dark mossy paths.
prompt: A single magical night image of a garden where open books grow like luminous flowers, pages glowing blue-green, fireflies hovering, dark moss, stone path, bioluminescent plants, dreamy science-fantasy, no readable text, no logos, no watermark.
caption: Some stories grow instead of being read.
